note: each row names the layer that must refuse it; at P4 the parity harness drives the script rows through kaspa-txscript against the compiled template and asserts the named failure

vectors.name: premature_claim_sequence_lock
vectors.description: A commit-timeout claim broadcast before the window: the claim input carries sequence = W, and the state UTXO is younger than W.
vectors.enforcer: check_sequence_lock rejects until the spent UTXO is `sequence` DAA old (tx_validation_in_utxo_context.rs:136-155 at cfafeb4c)

vectors.name: premature_claim_low_sequence
vectors.description: A claim built with sequence < W to slip the consensus lock: the script's CSV guard reads W from the template and the input's sequence is below it.
vectors.enforcer: OpCheckSequenceVerify fails when stack_sequence > input.sequence (opcodes/mod.rs, UnsatisfiedLockTime)

vectors.name: premature_claim_disabled_bit
vectors.description: A claim built with sequence = W | SEQUENCE_LOCK_TIME_DISABLED (1<<63): consensus FILTERS disabled-bit inputs out of the sequence lock, so the script's CSV arm is the only wall standing.
vectors.enforcer: OpCheckSequenceVerify refuses a spending input whose sequence carries the disabled bit (opcodes/mod.rs:1093-1094 at cfafeb4c) — the one premature shape with a single enforcement layer; the P4 harness must execute it

vectors.name: premature_dead_man
vectors.description: A dead-man settlement attempted before the 36000-DAA statute.

vectors.name: claim_without_standing
vectors.description: A claim from a state where the claimant's own commit/reveal is absent (nobody acted).
vectors.enforcer: the claim branch requires the claimant's slot to be present in state — no such entrypoint exists (STATES.md standing rule)

vectors.name: claim_when_opponent_acted
vectors.description: A commit-timeout claim while the opponent's commitment is already in state.
vectors.enforcer: the claim branch requires the counterparty's slot to be absent

vectors.name: commit_wrong_signer
vectors.description: B's key signing into A's commitment slot.
vectors.enforcer: the commit branch checks the signature against the slot owner's registered session_pk or payout_pk

vectors.name: commit_duplicate_hash
vectors.description: The second commitment byte-equal to the first (copy attempt).
vectors.enforcer: explicit inequality check at the second commit (pvp §4 defense-in-depth)

vectors.name: reveal_wrong_preimage
vectors.description: A reveal whose (zone, salt) does not hash to the stored commitment under the revealer's identity fields.
vectors.enforcer: Blake2b(domain ‖ covenant_id ‖ round ‖ role ‖ session_pk ‖ zone ‖ salt) mismatch

vectors.name: reveal_cross_round_replay
vectors.description: Replaying round N's preimage in round N+1.
vectors.enforcer: the round number is an identity field in the reconstructed hash

vectors.name: reveal_cross_match_replay
vectors.description: Replaying a preimage from another match.
vectors.enforcer: the covenant id is an identity field in the reconstructed hash

vectors.name: commit_in_reveal_phase
vectors.description: A commit attempted while both commitments are already in state.
vectors.enforcer: phase dispatch: the commit branch requires an empty own slot in the committing phase

vectors.name: overdraw_fee
vectors.description: A transition whose successor value is more than the fee cap below the input value.
vectors.enforcer: value floor: next.value >= self.value - FEE_CAP, and never below stakes + bonds

vectors.name: settle_unregistered_payout
vectors.description: A settlement output paying a script public key that is not the genesis-registered payout of the entitled player.
vectors.enforcer: output introspection pins every settlement output to registered payout SPKs (OpTxOutputSpk)

vectors.name: dead_man_wrong_split
vectors.description: A dead-man settlement paying the pot to the trailing player.
vectors.enforcer: the settle branch computes the payout from the state's scores; any other output layout fails introspection

vectors.name: sd_elimination_check
vectors.description: An elimination settlement attempted during sudden death.
vectors.enforcer: the elimination comparison is gated on regulation mode (§7 disabled in SD)

vectors.name: successor_state_tamper
vectors.description: A transition whose successor output carries a state the transition function did not produce (wrong score after a reveal).
vectors.enforcer: successor validation recomputes and pins template ‖ state for the covenant output
